response.overview: The biggest show in 1PW history headlined by Europes first ever No Ropes Barbed Wire Hell match between 1PW Champion Steve Corino and "The Monster " Abyss also features the absolute classic AJ Styles vs Pac bout, along with a tag team ladder match, European Death Match, and a star studded lineup including Samoa Joe, Dustin Rhodes, Christopher Daniels , Tracy Smothers and many more.
response.title: 1PW: First Anniversary Show
